title: sex_gender_analysis/1.0: the analytical layer around the vendored sex/gender parser
description: The full block src/sex_gender_analysis.analyze returns for one trial (published as a row of sex_gender_analysis.csv.gz) and, under $defs/lean, the per-study subset that rides in the published parts under the study key sex_gender_analysis. A record published before this layer carries no such key; readers say the newer analysis is unavailable and never manufacture a value from the legacy counts. Every absent quantity is null, never zero. Layer as_run: derived from the parser's as-run output; the manuscript's FINAL states (manual reconciliation) are not reproduced.

rules_version.description: The analytical rules this block was derived under (src/sex_gender_analysis.RULES_VERSION). Values are comparable only under one rules version.

sex_report_status.description: The parser's own five-state status, untouched.

dimension.description: eTable 1 panel A: sex only, both, gender only, neither; parse_error is an operational failure, not a substantive state.

neither_reason.description: The three sub-states of neither (eTable 1); null for every other dimension.

explicit_unknown_with_values.description: An explicit Unknown count beside reported values (eTable 1 panel B). Both are kept; null on parse_error.

eligible.description: Enters the composition and percent-female denominators (reported_sex AND is_participant_count AND Female + Male > 0); null on parse_error.

incomplete_composition.description: Female and male counts covering only some participants, or clusters (eMethods 2). null until evaluated; a false is only ever a measured false.

incomplete_composition_evaluated.description: Whether incomplete_composition was evaluated at all. A null value with evaluated false is an unevaluated quantity, never proof of complete composition.

status.description: derived: at least one gender-identity category posted and no exclusion applied; not_applicable: no such category posted; excluded: an eTable 5 exclusion applied (counts kept for audit, never summed into D3 aggregates).

categories.description: eTable 5 gender-identity categories (D3). Each is the largest value across the count-driving tables, or null when no table posted it.

another_self_described.description: Includes rows labeled only Other (the documented bare-Other convention).

separate.description: Rows reported separately, never as gender diverse (eTable 5).

d3_total.description: Sum of the posted D3 categories (eTable 5 total, gender identity categories). An aggregate operational rule, not person-level deduplication.

d5_strict.description: D3 without another_self_described: the strict lower bound.

two_question_table.description: A count-driving table carries Female/Male rows beside gender-identity rows (the same participants counted under sex and under gender).

possible_double_count.description: More than one count-driving table carries gender-identity rows; the max rule applied.

unclassified_labels.description: Labels the parser bucketed as gender diverse or cis/trans-qualified that no eTable 5 pattern matched; surfaced for review, never counted.

unresolved.description: The rule-matrix ids this block leaves open.

lean.title: The per-study subset in the published parts (study.sex_gender_analysis)
